findings.description: Direct inspection of V206 crouch and sit renders still shows the front thighs exposed because the armature-follow lap panels do not maintain anterior coverage; the detached cloth-simulated back panels also create a visible front/rear hem break. Required seated/crouched skirt coverage remains unusable.

Neutral, front, three-quarter and side views retain dense angular crushed folds across the overskirt surface. Changing front panels to armature-only has not produced the intended broad, orderly pleat channels.

Prone view still tents and bunches the overskirt; side views retain trailing hem discontinuity, and gray gaps remain at sleeve roots/armholes. These are direct appearance observations, not fit or collision measurements.

nextAction: Keep V206 rejected. The measured 0.16 m body-weight transfer completed, but direct crouch/sit renders show the front-lap armature path does not maintain anterior thigh coverage and breaks continuity against the rear cloth panels. Replace the split deformation approach with a panel-coherent response that retains front coverage in seated and crouched poses, then reshape the crushed pleat surface. Rebuild and directly inspect all five views and six poses. Shape Key, fit, production rig/weight, Unity/VRChat, package and release remain unverified.
